description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC action filter named ValidatorActionFilter that validates model state before the execution of an action, returning JSON-formatted validation errors with HTTP status 422 if the model state is invalid.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core MVC action filter that intercepts action execution to validate model state and returns JSON errors with status 422 if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Intercepts the execution of an action to check if the model state is valid; if not, constructs an error response with details and sets it as the result.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: An empty implementation of the IActionFilter method called after an action executes, included as part of the interface.
